PrincipalRecord.title: PrincipalRecord
PrincipalRecord.description: Published principal record: the immutable principal content, its lifecycle state, and the SHA-256 digest of the content.

IdentityRecordVersion.title: IdentityRecordVersion
IdentityRecordVersion.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized identity record (currently 1).

Principal.title: Principal
Principal.description: Immutable, content-addressed principal: opaque id, participant kind, display name. Carries no tenant, no membership, and no credential material.

PrincipalId.title: PrincipalId
PrincipalId.description: Opaque, prefixed principal identity: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug. Never encodes a tenant, provider, or credential.

PrincipalKind.title: PrincipalKind
PrincipalKind.description: Principal kind: human, agent (registered autonomous participant), or service (machine client).

PrincipalLifecycleState.title: PrincipalLifecycleState
PrincipalLifecycleState.description: Principal lifecycle: active, suspended (advisory hold — authentication fails inactive-principal), or deactivated (terminal).
